en: Colorized view of central Ljubljana with the Ljubljanica River and a stone bridge in the foreground, opening onto the main square with the pink Franciscan Church of the Annunciation and surrounding buildings. People are visible in the square. The front caption reads "Ljubljana Marijin trg." The reverse shows handwritten Italian text, an address, a circular Ljubljana postmark and a green 5-value stamp.
